_about: Evidence-reviewed classification of every AEM component found by tag-pattern analysis (aem-block-inventory.json). Boilerplate = maps to a block in the EDS boilerplate/Block Collection library (Table, Columns, Cards, Video, Accordion, Hero, Carousel, Tabs, Search, Embed, Quote). Custom = needs bespoke EDS block code. variantRules (first match on the variant's tag pattern / style / modifier tokens) override the component default.

articleheader.rationale: On 431 article pages. Tag pattern section(div(rte),div(div(rte),div(div(rte),div)),div)+div[dialog]: title, category chip, publish date and computed read-time are page-metadata driven, plus a share dialog. No Block Collection equivalent — build as an auto-block from page metadata.

relatedcontent.rationale: Query-driven 'related articles / products' rail (data-category, data-card-type) rendered as a slick carousel of linked cards (a(div,div(rte,div),div(rte))+ with prev/next buttons). Cards are selected by tags at runtime, not authored — needs a query-index driven block (carousel + cards behaviour).

variantRules.note: 'product' card-type variant (related products, two-column, no slider when ≤2 items) — same custom block, product query.

articlelisting.rationale: Filterable article listing: tag-filter nav(button+), hidden input state, AJAX endpoint (_jcr_content/…/articlelisting.html, data-tag-id) and 'load more'. Needs a query-index listing block with filters.

productcategory.rationale: Product range listing per category (data-category, data-product-number) with per-product expandable details (button[exp] + div[exp]) and 'Show more' paging — product-data driven list; no standard block combines card list + expand + paging.

contactform.rationale: 18-field enquiry form (country/product selects, checkbox consent, reCAPTCHA data-sitekey) posting to a marketing backend. No form block in the boilerplate library; needs a form block + submission integration.

anchorlinks.rationale: Sticky in-page jump navigation (afpHeroBanner-alinks) under the hero on 22 chef/landing pages. Content is a plain link list but the sticky/scroll-spy behaviour needs a small custom block.

bodyrte.rationale: Rich text with a 'Read more / Read less' toggle (data-readmoretext, data-readlesstext, button). Small custom block (or a text variant).

variantRules.note: Empty rich-text instance — authored as default content.

homepageherobanner.rationale: AEM carousel (data-cmp-hook-carousel, role=group/tabpanel slides, numbered dots) of hero slides → Block Collection Carousel (hero-style slides).

variantRules.note: Single-slide with background <video> → Hero (video background variant).

herobanner.rationale: Text + image banner (afpHeroBanner textImage) → Hero. textYouTube variants open a YouTube modal → Hero with video link (Video/modal).

variantRules.note: Hero with play button opening a YouTube dialog → Hero + Video (modal) variant.

productbanner.rationale: Product detail banner (title, product image, enlarge-image dialog) → Hero (product variant) on 29 product pages.

pagebanner.rationale: Page title banner (afpHeroBanner, background colour) → Hero (text-only / colour variants).

leftrightcontent.rationale: Two-column text + media split (div(div(rte)+,div(a)),div(media)) → Columns. Variants differ by media (image / video / YouTube dialog / contact table).

variantRules.note: Columns with a YouTube dialog on the media side → Columns + Video (modal).
Team-contact layout (photo + details table) → Columns (contacts variant).

iconcards.rationale: Repeated card items (img, rte, optional CTA / whole-card link) → Cards. Modifier tokens (twoColumn/threeColumn, images/icons, simple, headlineCopy) become Cards variants.

variantRules.note: headlineCopy layout: lead image beside a list of icon + text features → Columns.
Year-by-year history grid (timeline look) — Cards with a 'timeline' variant style.

accordionItem.rationale: aria-expanded header + collapsible panel (div[exp](div(rte)),div[exp](...)). AEM authors one component per item; EDS Accordion groups consecutive items. Panels that nest other components (@iconcards, @gridlayout) need nested-block content (Medium).

catalogueCalculatorPromo.rationale: Promo strip: heading/copy left, icon + label + CTA right → Columns.

video.rationale: YouTube poster image + data-video (ytvideo) → Block Collection Video (YouTube with placeholder image).

search.rationale: Site search results page (query form, product + article hit lists, paging data-hitsperpage) → Block Collection Search, re-pointed from the AEM search servlet to the EDS query index.

text.rationale: AEM rich-text component → EDS default content.

variantRules.note: Rich text containing a <table> (nutritional / spec / recipe tables) → Table block.

sectionheader.rationale: Section heading + intro copy → default content (section style).

anchor.rationale: Invisible anchor target (div(a)) → not migrated; EDS sections/headings provide ids.

gridlayout.rationale: Layout component → EDS section; background / width modifiers (bgDigitalDarkBlue, bgWhite, bgred, narrow, fullwidth…) → section-metadata styles.

variantRules.note: Grid row with side-by-side child components (e.g. text | image) → Columns.

container.rationale: Page root container → EDS page body / sections.

header.rationale: Experience-fragment header. Global EN = mega-menu (nested dropdown panels, back buttons, search form); Domino's Colab / Yum!Live share a simpler nav + search. → EDS header fragment (nav document) per property.

footer.rationale: Experience-fragment footer (link columns, logo, back-to-top). Global EN and the two microsites use different footers → one EDS footer fragment per property.
